title: Topic 9
japanese_text: Aさんはいつも<u>愛想</u>がよく<u>温厚な</u>人なのだが、Bさんとは気が合わないらしい。それで、<u>素っ気ない</u>返事をするなど<u>露骨に</u>態度に出すので、同じ空間にいると<u>息が詰まる</u>。
english_translation: Mr. A is usually very amiable and good-natured, but he and Mr. B don't seem to get along. He blatantly shows his poor attitude, such as giving curt replies, creating a suffocating atmosphere whenever they're in the same space.
